data.name: root
data.value: Your repositories as one workspace: for people, for CI and for agents.

data.name: option.root
data.value: Folder to act on (the current one by default).

data.name: option.output
data.value: human (by default); json, a document; ndjson, events and then the document. Stable, always in English.

data.name: option.non-interactive
data.value: No questions and no live progress, whatever the terminal (for scripts and CI).

data.name: option.space
data.value: Act on the nearest space that mounts others, itself included, from anywhere inside it.

data.name: option.lang
data.value: Language of the messages: en or es (by default, FX_LANG or the system's).

data.name: sync
data.value: Generate and update what fx owns here and in everything mounted below, from the _fx configuration.

data.name: sync.dry-run
data.value: Show what would change, without writing.

data.name: sync.offline
data.value: No network: do not fetch the repositories.

data.name: sync.adopt
data.value: Take over files written by hand (without the GENERATED header).

data.name: doctor
data.value: Check, without changing anything, that what fx owns here and below is right.

data.name: doctor.offline
data.value: No network: do not ask the remotes.

data.name: module
data.value: Only this module: mounts, dotnet or harness.

data.name: mount
data.value: The mounts of the space: the repositories and spaces it brings in.

data.name: mount.list
data.value: The mounts of mounts.yaml: where, their mode, whether they are required and whether they are here.

data.name: mount.status
data.value: The mounts here that ask for attention: branch, commits ahead and behind, changes.

data.name: mount.status.all
data.value: Also the mounts that are clean and up to date.

data.name: mount.some-clean
data.value: {0} of {1} mounts are clean (--all to see them).

data.name: mount.unpark
data.value: Unpark mounts: a parked one comes back now; fx sync clones what is missing.

data.name: mount.park
data.value: Park mounts: their clones go to _fx/~$parking/, never deleted.

data.name: mount.pull
data.value: Fast-forward the mounts here that have a clean working tree.

data.name: version
data.value: The version this repository would build now, from its git history.

data.name: version.explain
data.value: Show how the version was calculated.

data.name: version.branch-commits
data.value: {0} commits since main was last merged

data.name: version.rule.feature
data.value: X.Y.{tag → merge base}-feature.{name}.{commits since main was last merged}

data.name: version.tag
data.value: Create the tag version/X.Y.0 on HEAD to start a new minor or major (local; push it yourself).

data.name: version.tag.argument
data.value: The new major and minor, like 11.3.

data.name: version.tag.created
data.value: Created {0} on {1}. It is local: git push origin {0}

data.name: help.more
data.value: fx <command> --help: the detail of a command.

data.name: mount.nothing-to-park
data.value: No mount can be parked: the required ones cannot.

data.name: usage.help
data.value: fx --help lists the commands; fx <command> --help explains one.

data.name: usage.missing
data.value: Missing {0}, and there is no terminal to ask for it:

data.name: mount.add
data.value: Add a mount to mounts.yaml, where you say; its name comes from the URL unless --name. Nothing is cloned.

data.name: mount.add.url
data.value: The URL to clone it from.

data.name: mount.add.name
data.value: Its name (by default, from the URL: Fuxion-docs.git → fuxion-docs).

data.name: mount.add.path
data.value: Where it is mounted, relative to the space: the layout is yours.

data.name: mount.add.required
data.value: Required: always there, it cannot be parked (by default, each copy parks it or brings it back).

data.name: mount.add.mode
data.value: Its mode: write (by default), read-only or propose-only.

data.name: mount.remove
data.value: Take a mount out of mounts.yaml; its clone stays.

data.name: mount.tag
data.value: Add tags to a mount, or remove them (--remove).

data.name: mount.tag.remove
data.value: Remove the tags instead of adding them.

data.name: mount.set
data.value: Change a key of a mount: url, path, required, mode, depends-on or inherits.

data.name: modules
data.value: The modules of fx in this root: a folder of _fx each.

data.name: module.enable
data.value: Enable a module: create its folder in _fx, or take out its enabled: false.

data.name: module.disable
data.value: Turn a module off without losing its configuration (enabled: false).

data.name: module.name
data.value: The module: mounts, dotnet or harness.

data.name: module.tag
data.value: The tags of the repositories it goes down to (its applies-to).

data.name: manifest.dry-run-option
data.value: Show the change, without writing it.

data.name: mount.ask.tags-add
data.value: Tags to add, separated by spaces

data.name: mount.ask.path
data.value: Folder to mount it in, relative to the space

data.name: mount.add.guest
data.value: A guest: the space uses it, but it inherits from its own parent (inherits: false).

data.name: path
data.value: What the git of the space versions (paths: of _fx/space.yaml).

data.name: path.add
data.value: Version a file or a folder (ending in /) of the space; nothing is created.

data.name: path.remove
data.value: Stop versioning a path; nothing is deleted.

data.name: path.name
data.value: The path, relative to the space (a folder ends in /).

data.name: path.exclude
data.value: An exception inside something versioned (exclude: true).

data.name: path.no-worktree
data.value: Left out of the worktrees of the space (worktree: false).

data.name: sync.only
data.value: Only this root, not what is mounted below it (nor the map of FxReference).

data.name: sync.parent-ref
data.value: Read the parent from its remote, on this branch (to try what it gives, without versioning the choice).

data.name: mount.rename
data.value: Rename a mount: its references in this space change, and the old name stays in aliases.

data.name: worktree
data.value: Worktrees: a branch to work on apart, without touching the main tree.

data.name: worktree.add
data.value: Create a worktree of a branch in the nearest workspace (or --in), with where you are mounted in it.

data.name: worktree.mount
data.value: Mount more of the tree in a worktree: repositories (with the workspaces on the way) or paths left out.

data.name: worktree.unmount
data.value: Take repositories out of a worktree (not with uncommitted changes).

data.name: worktree.list
data.value: The worktrees of the workspaces around here.

data.name: worktree.remove
data.value: Remove a worktree (not with uncommitted changes); the branches fx created go if git deletes them safely.

data.name: worktree.in
data.value: The workspace where it goes: one of those above, by name, full name or path.

data.name: worktree.required
data.value: Also the required mounts of what is mounted, down.

data.name: worktree.mount.targets
data.value: Repositories (name, path or full name) or paths left out.

data.name: describe
data.value: fx described by itself: every command, what it outputs and what it does (with --output json, for agents).

data.name: schema
data.value: The JSON Schema of an output of fx; without an id, the list of them.

data.name: describe.exit-code.0
data.value: Done, without errors (there may be warnings).

data.name: describe.exit-code.1
data.value: Done, with errors: the diagnostics say which and how to fix them.

data.name: describe.exit-code.2
data.value: Wrong usage: an unknown command or option, a missing value, or something fx would ask with no one to ask.

data.name: describe.more
data.value: fx describe --output json gives all of it, with the arguments and options of each command; fx schema, the schemas of the JSON.

data.name: schema.more
data.value: fx schema <id>: the JSON Schema of one.

data.name: fx.unknown-schema
data.value: fx has no schema '{0}': fx schema lists them.

data.name: help.exit-codes
data.value: Exit codes: 0 done, 1 errors, 2 wrong usage, 130 cancelled. fx describe: every command, for agents.

data.name: ui.no-terminal
data.value: fx ui needs a terminal with a person in front: here there is none (CI, a pipe, an agent or --output json).

data.name: help.ui
data.value: the workspace in full screen (in a terminal; Ctrl+Q closes it)

data.name: ui.key.all.description
data.value: Show also what does not matter to fx, and the local files.

data.name: ui.key.refresh.description
data.value: Read the tree again and run the doctor again.

data.name: ui.select
data.value: Select a node of the tree.

data.name: ui.guest

data.name: ui.superseded

data.name: ui.parked

data.name: ui.unknown.folder
data.value: A folder with files that the workspace does not version: version it, or leave it local.

data.name: ui.file.generated
data.value: Generated by fx: not edited by hand; it is regenerated by

data.name: ui.folder.inherited

data.name: ui.more
data.value: The rest of it does not matter to fx: F3 shows it.

data.value: Go to where this file comes from

data.name: ui.key.back.description
data.value: Go back to where you were

data.name: ui.key.main.description
